races.name: 1XBET.IE IRISH RACING PARTNERSHIP Optional Claiming Race

runners_data.name: Rock Iguana
runners_data.note: Alan Casey (7lb claimer) keeps the weight low on this 4yo who has placed twice at 7f on Standard and is likely to track Profit Surge from a favourable stall; his sim-going record on Good shows no wins in seven attempts, which is the one concern|
runners_data.comment: Rock Iguana shaped well when second two starts back and again five starts back, and has run over today's trip; drawn in stall four carrying 139 lb, he rates a strong danger, though winless in his last five starts remains the concern.

runners_data.name: Inishfallen
runners_data.note: Jack Kearney (3lb) partners this 5yo for Stephen Thorne who is 0/10 in the last 14 days — ran just 10 days ago and placed twice over 6f on Good this season, though stepping to 7f is an open question given all five recent runs were at six or shorter|
runners_data.comment: Ran a solid second two starts back and returns on a quick turnaround of just 10 days, with experience of today's trip and conditions working in his favour; yet to win in recent starts, but our rating has him clear of this field and that second gives him solid claims.

runners_data.name: Cladach
runners_data.note: Joseph O'Brien's 3yo drops from an OR of 120 into an optional claimer which is the headline angle — only two career starts (4th and 9th on Good), both short of experience, but the class drop could make him very dangerous if Dylan Browne McMonagle can find cover from a hold-up position|
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last two starts, including ninth on his most recent outing, Cladach is hard to fancy from a low ranking on our figures; he has experience over today's trip and conditions, and 14 days between runs suggests he arrives fresh.

runners_data.name: Slight Of Foot
runners_data.note: Donagh O'Connor takes the ride on this lightly-raced 3yo whose best effort was a 2nd at 7f on Standard; genuinely hold-up in style, he has no sim-going win in six attempts on Good and has failed to fire at the longer trips in recent starts|
runners_data.comment: Slight Of Foot shaped with promise when fourth two starts back, and he has experience over today's trip and going, arriving here fit on just 11 days' rest — the main concern is that he's winless in his last five starts and carries a hefty 136 lb from stall 12.

runners_data.name: Spent All Me Money
runners_data.note: Adrian Sexton's 4yo is a natural hold-up performer who has won twice on Good at 7f, but the crowded rear of this field means he has been pushed into a midfield graphic position he won't naturally occupy — form is deeply negative (000) since those wins and the style compromise tempers confidence|
runners_data.comment: Landed a win five starts back but has gone unplaced in every run since, making his recent form a concern; he has run over today's trip and carries 130 lb from stall 11, though our rating of 67 suggests he retains some ability.

runners_data.name: Spirit Of Eagles
runners_data.note: Thomas Dowling fields this 6yo tongue-tied veteran who at heart races from the back, with his last five runs ranging from 5-6f and this 7f trip looking a stretch — won once over 6f on Good but the redistribution to a midfield slot means he will not find his true rhythm in this configuration|
runners_data.comment: Spirit Of Eagles brings experience over today's trip and going, and her third three starts back shows she can hit the frame, but sixth and eighth in her last two outings are harder to ignore, and a mark of 57 suggests she faces a stiff task from stall one carrying 129 lb.

runners_data.name: Snowballs
runners_data.note: W McCreery's 4yo wears a visor and is a true hold-up type shunted into a midfield slot by the crowd of closers; best of five recent runs was a 5th over 5f on Good and there is no evidence of effectiveness at 7f, making this a very tough ask despite the headgear|
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last six starts, with unplaced efforts dominating recent form, Snowballs is hard to fancy at the foot of our rankings here; he does arrive on a reasonable 14-day turnaround and has run over today's trip and going before, which counts for something.

runners_data.name: Menwirr
runners_data.note: Denis Hogan's 3yo wears a hood and missed 73 days before this — naturally a rear-of-field runner whose only sim-going run produced a 7th, and occupying a midfield position that is not his natural berth means his finishing kick will struggle to materialise from off the pace on a good surface|
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last four starts and ranked 12 of 14 on our figures, Menwirr has been largely out of the frame in recent outings, though he does have experience over today's trip and going; 73 days off adds a fitness query.

runners_data.name: Princess Chloe
runners_data.note: Terry Casey (7lb) partners this 3yo for Daniel Murphy who is 0/7 in the last 14 days — wears a hood and has placed at 2nd over 6f on Good, but a true hold-up racer shifted into a midfield berth; her best chance arrives if the pace ignites and gaps open late|
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last six starts, Princess Chloe faces a stiff task ranked 11th of 14 on our figures, and a speed rating of 56 does little to inspire confidence; a second two starts back at least hints at some ability, and she has run over today's trip before.

runners_data.name: Green Kite
runners_data.note: Shane Foley is the classiest jockey booking in this field for Kevin Coleman's 4yo, but the horse is flagged as a fader in the finish and has failed to win in 8+ sim-going starts — a hold-up type mapped to midfield means Foley's handiest asset (positioning) is somewhat neutralised|
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts, Green Kite does at least bring distance experience and a recent outing 30 days ago — a second two starts back offers some encouragement — though ranked tenth of fourteen on our ratings, the 134 lb burden gives him plenty to overcome.

runners_data.name: Hexagonal
runners_data.note: Denis Hogan's 5yo wears tongue-tie and returned 7 days ago to win over 10f on Good at a completely different distance — the step down to 7f is sharp, but his prominent style and Reese Holohan's 7lb claim keeps him competitive as a tracker directly behind Profit Surge|
runners_data.comment: Hexagonal won two starts back but has been unplaced on either side of that success, and his overall recent form is patchy. He has run over today's trip and returns on a quick turnaround, though his 134 lb burden is a stiff ask.

runners_data.name: Profit Surge
runners_data.note: Colin Keane drives this Gerard Keane-trained 5yo who wears tongue-tie and a blinker combination and has been placed in five of his last six on Good over 5-8f — sole genuine front-runner, uncontested lead on a sound surface is precisely the scenario that suits him most|
runners_data.comment: Consistent place-getter but yet to win in her last six starts, Profit Surge brings strong recent form — third last time out, and placed in each of her five most recent — with distance experience an asset; the short four-day turnaround and a middle-draw stall eight are the key questions here.

runners_data.name: Thurso
runners_data.note: Ben Coen's mount for Gerard O'Leary is 27 days fresh, wears a hood, and has won over 6f on Firm — his one win in 15 sim-going runs gives cause for pause but he is the most plausible threat from a hold-up position if a genuine finishing test emerges late|
runners_data.comment: Thurso landed a win three starts back and arrives here fit on a 27-day turnaround, with experience of today's distance and going working in his favour and our rating putting him marginally above his official mark. The worry is that he's been unplaced on his latest outing.

runners_data.name: Mo Anam Chara
runners_data.note: Ronan Whelan picks up this Mark Fahey 3yo returning after 81 days off — a winner over 1m on Good with a placed run at 8f, he is a genuine closer by trade shuffled toward midfield by the hold-up crowd; the shorter 7f trip and long layoff add risk, but the form core gives him a live each-way profile if Whelan can find room|
runners_data.comment: Won last time out but returns after 81 days off, and her our rating of 66 sits below her official mark — she has run over today's trip, though her record in recent starts shows inconsistency either side of that latest victory.

races.paceDynamic: Profit Surge is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 14-runner field and, ridden by Colin Keane, is expected to stride into an uncontested lead at a sustainable gallop on Good to Firm ground — his form string of 632233 underlines he consistently finds his rhythm in front without being pressured. Rock Iguana and Hexagonal are the nearest prominent types likely to track just off the leader, but neither has the gate speed or inclination to challenge Profit Surge for the front, meaning the early fractions should be honest rather than fierce. The field holds considerably more hold-up and prominent types than the map can accommodate at the rear — Mo Anam Chara, Spent All Me Money, Green Kite, and Menwirr are all genuine hold-up performers redistributed to the midfield graphic because they simply cannot all get their natural position; Profit Surge, Rock Iguana, and Hexagonal are those most likely to actually secure their mapped positions near the front. With one uncontested pace-setter dictating a controlled tempo over 7 furlongs on a sound surface, this race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track the leader throughout and pounce in the straight, rather than true hold-up horses who will face a wall of traffic and a ground-level tempo that may not stretch the field enough to create gaps late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Profit Surge Controls Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Profit Surge is allowed to bowl along uncontested and Keane manages the fractions to deny any challenger a clear run at him
scenarios.body: Profit Surge slots into his habitual front-running groove and, with nobody willing to pressure him, he controls every yard and finds enough to hold on under Keane's polished front-riding; his five placed efforts at 7f on Good confirm he sees out the trip and rarely stops on this surface

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If a prominent racer stalks Profit Surge throughout and pounces in the final furlong as the pace-setter flattens
scenarios.body: Rock Iguana from stall 1 or Hexagonal, both tracking just off the tempo, are ideally positioned to react when the gap opens in the straight; on Good to Firm ground over 7f, a horse who has raced prominently throughout is best placed to accelerate past a tiring leader without needing daylight through a bunch

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sole Closer Splits The Field
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses dramatically in the straight, creating a split-field scenario that allows one late finisher to thread through
scenarios.body: Mo Anam Chara, with an OR-winning profile at a mile on Good, is the most credible beneficiary here — but the redistribution caveat applies and the expected controlled tempo limits how far back a true closer can afford to travel; Princess Chloe showed a 2nd at 6f on Good and could grab minor honours if the gaps materialise

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse, Chaos Late
scenarios.trigger: If Profit Surge goes off too fast or receives unexpected pressure from a rival surging early, blowing the field apart
scenarios.body: A messy, strung-out race with no true pacemaker surviving could theoretically release some of the redistributed hold-up horses — Spent All Me Money showed a win at 7f on Good and Thurso was a 6f winner on Firm — but this shape relies on horses racing entirely out of their shown positions and must carry the lowest weight

watchPoints.text: Profit Surge — Colin Keane must be tracked from the off; if he gets 2+ lengths clear by the 5f pole unchallenged, his wire-to-wire chance escalates sharply|

Green Kite — Shane Foley's positioning in the first half of the race is the tell; if Foley pushes forward early to escape the midfield crush, the fading pattern flagged in the form becomes the key risk factor for anything drawn outside him|

Cladach — the dramatic class drop from OR 120 into this optional claimer by Joseph O'Brien is the biggest form angle in the race; if Dylan Browne McMonagle delivers him with cover in mid-division, he could land a significant blow on unexposed form|

Hexagonal — the distance drop from 10f (where he won last time) to 7f is a significant unknown; watch for signs he is pulling hard early under Holohan, which could compromise his prominent run and hand the lead entirely to Profit Surge unchallenged|

Mo Anam Chara — 81 days off for Ronan Whelan's mount creates a fitness question; if he is stepped in the market in the final minutes before the off, treat the layoff concern as resolved and his closing profile becomes considerably more relevant|

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap

runners_data.name: Stugardia
runners_data.note: 306 days off the track is a significant concern for a hold-up filly operating from the rear; Joseph O'Brien's stable is in form (T14: 13/74) and the 7-pound claimer Julian Pietropaolo is a cost saver, but returning from nearly a year off on Good to Firm against a competitive mark of OR 91 makes this a speculative proposition until she proves her sharpness is retained.
runners_data.comment: Stugardia is a lightly raced filly who shaped with promise when third two starts back, and with 306 days between runs she arrives unexposed and open to improvement; yet to win, but there's more to come from this one.

runners_data.name: Greydreambeliever
runners_data.note: Back just eight days after her last run, Dylan Browne McMonagle takes over for the in-form O'Brien yard, and her recent sim-going figures show two places from two runs on Good-type ground at exactly this 7f trip — her natural closer's profile means she needs a clean run through what could be a congested midfield-to-rear section.
runners_data.comment: Greydreambeliever shaped with promise when second three starts back and again second five starts back, and her experience over today's trip and going underlines her claims; yet to score in recent starts, but she rates narrowly top of her eight rivals on our figures.

runners_data.name: Rion Rubette
runners_data.note: Arrives in the best recent form of any hold-up runner in this field with back-to-back wins including a 7f Good winner, and Paddy Harnett's 5lb claim reduces her weight burden; sim-going is acceptable at 9/15, and if the front-runners burn the race up this mare has the finishing form to be a major player.
runners_data.comment: Rion Rubette has back-to-back wins in her recent starts, showing sharp form, and she has experience over today's trip and going. The main risk is the unplaced effort last time out on a 41-day absence.

runners_data.name: Thrifty Of Digby
runners_data.note: Shane Foley pilots a confirmed front-runner who has two wins on Good ground and four wins from five placed efforts on similar surface, and the hood (hg:p) suggests she can be freshened and focused; her record is over longer trips (8-10f) so whether she truly sees out 7f at a contested gallop is the key stamina question.
runners_data.comment: Pulled up last time out is the jarring note for Thrifty Of Digby, and she ranks seventh of nine on our figures; the 48-day absence does nothing to ease those concerns. She has run over today's trip and boasts back-to-back wins two and three starts back, but the recent form makes her hard to fancy.

runners_data.name: Rebel Wave
runners_data.note: Won most recently over this exact 7f trip on Good and placed on Soft — compact profile at OR 79 and just three going-relevant runs, but the form is current (LR: 20d) and W J Lee rides a filly who is clearly going the right way; as a co-front-runner she must survive the early duel with Thrifty Of Digby to fulfil her chance.
runners_data.comment: Rebel Wave won last time out but her two most recent starts before that yielded a second and a sixth, and she ranks eighth of nine on our figures — hard to fancy at the foot of the ratings, though distance and going experience and a 20-day turnaround give her a fair enough pitch.

runners_data.name: Hasita
runners_data.note: Rory Mulligan's 5lb claim helps in a weight sense, but this filly's heart is in the hold-up role — her last four runs all show her racing from off the pace — and being crowded into a midfield position against her natural instincts by the volume of closers in this race means she may never fully get into the race with her characteristic late effort.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last five starts, Hasita does bring distance experience and a rating of 86 to the table, but consecutive placed efforts have given way to a fifth last time out, making the step back into contention less than straightforward from stall 3 off 119 lb.

runners_data.name: Mallavelly
runners_data.note: Colin Keane is a top booking for G M Lyons and Mallavelly has two wins and five places from ten runs on Good ground, including a placed effort at this 7f trip; the tack (hg:t) is familiar, yet her instinct to close from the rear places her in the same overcrowded late sector as other redistributed hold-up types — Keane's positional intelligence gives her a better chance of carving a run than most.
runners_data.comment: Mallavelly has been knocking on the door, finishing third last time out and second two starts back, and she has run over today's trip and going before — her rating of 94 puts her right in contention. The seventh three starts back is the one blot to dismiss.

runners_data.name: Akecheta
runners_data.note: All five recent runs have come at 10f or longer, so dropping sharply back to 7f on Good to Firm is a clear distance concern for Kevin Coleman's six-year-old, even if her prominent style suits the tactical shape; the 0W1P on sim-going from 15 attempts is a damning stat for a horse who needs things to go right at a track she has not shown obvious course affinity.
runners_data.comment: Akecheta has run over today's trip and going before, and a rating of 96 marks her out as a serious threat — but her recent run of five winless starts, including a seventh last time out, is the obvious concern on the way back from 67 days off.

runners_data.name: Pretty Omagh Girl
runners_data.note: Ben Coen rides a filly with a recent win at 8f on Good ground (OR form includes a 1 from just 40 days ago) and her prominent style is ideally suited to tracking a contested pace without being caught in the front-runners' skirmish; the step back to 7f from her winning trip of 8f could be a slight concern, but her two Good-ground placed efforts suggest she handles the surface confidently.
runners_data.comment: Pretty Omagh Girl won two starts back but has been unplaced on her most recent outing, and 40 days off the track is a query; she has run over today's trip and carries 133 lb from stall two.

races.paceDynamic: Thrifty Of Digby and Rebel Wave are both confirmed front-runners who will contest the lead from the gates in this 7f Good to Firm contest at Gowran, creating a genuinely contested early gallop rather than a soft, dawdling tempo. With two genuine pace horses duelling for supremacy, the fractions should be honest to strong, stretching the field out through the early stages and making this a true test of stamina for a 7f trip. Akecheta and Pretty Omagh Girl will press from a prominent pitch, adding further pressure to the pace-setters and ensuring there is no let-up. The field holds more hold-up types than the race shape can accommodate naturally — Mallavelly and Hasita are true closers redistributed to the midfield map position, meaning they are unlikely to find the same space off the pace they would ordinarily seek, and Greydreambeliever and Stugardia face genuine traffic challenges from the rear. This contested, honest gallop shapes the race decisively in favour of hold-up runners with strong finishing kicks — provided the pace truly burns itself out — but with multiple closers crowding the rear, those who can travel prominently or produce a relentless mid-race cruise from just off the pace carry the tactical edge.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Contested Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Thrifty Of Digby and Rebel Wave burn each other off at honest fractions, setting up a strong late surge from the rear.
scenarios.body: The two front-runners draw the sting from each other through the first three furlongs, leaving the field strung out and the final 2f open for runners with a sustained late kick to reel them in. True hold-up horses with form on Good to Firm and the ability to produce a clean run from midfield are the primary beneficiaries of this shape.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Pair Dominate Unchallenged
scenarios.trigger: If neither Thrifty Of Digby nor Rebel Wave cracks under early pressure and one sustains a controlled lead to the line.
scenarios.body: One of the two pace-setters — most likely the one who secures the softer position — finds a natural rhythm after the initial skirmish and rations her effort to hold on up the straight. Good to Firm ground suits a front-runner's cause by rewarding clean, economical striding rather than the grinding conditions that would blunt a tearaway.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Late Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent duo of Akecheta and Pretty Omagh Girl track the pace at a sustainable clip and produce enough to overhaul a weakening front pair.
scenarios.body: Sitting a length or two off the pace allows both to avoid being caught in the front-runners' firefight while still conserving energy for a prolonged challenge from the two-furlong pole. Pretty Omagh Girl's recent win at this trip and surface makes her the more credible of this pair to finish with purpose if the race unfolds at a manageable gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Closers Fail To Materialise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is just strong enough to string the field out but traffic congestion blunts the finish of the redistributed hold-up types.
scenarios.body: With Mallavelly and Hasita both squeezed into unnatural midfield berths and Greydreambeliever and Stugardia further back, the closing brigade faces a congested highway through the final two furlongs with limited room to unleash their full finish. In this shape the race falls to the most resolute prominent-running type who avoided the early pace-duel entirely and threads through a messy finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch whether Thrifty Of Digby or Rebel Wave blinks first in the opening furlong — if one concedes the lead early and settles, the pace duel dissolves and the race shape could flip entirely in favour of the prominent types rather than true closers.

Mallavelly and Hasita are both natural closers squeezed into midfield — if they are shuffled wide or lose position early chasing cover, Colin Keane and Rory Mulligan will need significant gaps to open in the straight that a congested 9-runner field may not provide.

Akecheta's consistent record at 10f with zero wins on similar going from 15 attempts makes her a significant trip and form-shape risk at 7f; watch for her dropping out if the pace is strong, which would further compress the midfield.

Pretty Omagh Girl mapping to a prominent pitch is the most tactically tidy position in this race — Ben Coen can track the pace duel two lengths off, avoid the rear-end traffic, and challenge once the front-runners begin to feel the pinch in the final furlong.

Greydreambeliever's eight-day turnaround under Dylan Browne McMonagle for an in-form yard is worth monitoring in the market — if heavily supported given the high-profile booking, it signals stable confidence that the quick return is intentional and the filly is cherry-ripe.

races.name: Edward Doran's Birthday Handicap

runners_data.name: Ohailbhic
runners_data.note: Natural hold-up horse for Ronan Whelan and John James Feane; won twice at 8f on Standside going but this 7f Gowran contest on Good to Firm is a step up in pace requirements, and a modest recent form line (-83117) conceals the fact that its two wins came on different terrain — needs a strong pace to deliver from rear.
runners_data.comment: Ohailbhic won back-to-back two and three starts back but disappointed on his latest outing, and a return to form is needed here; he has run over today's trip and going before, though carrying 140 lb from stall ten adds to the challenge.

runners_data.name: Alfred Tennyson
runners_data.note: Denis Gerard Hogan's 4yo carries a tongue-tie and travels prominently, which is ideal for this shape; recorded four placed efforts from nine outings on Good going and was runner-up over 6f here recently — the drop back to prominent racing on a fair pace suits his profile well.
runners_data.comment: Alfred Tennyson shaped with promise when third last time out, and a second five starts back underlines his competitive profile; he has run over today's trip and going, and our rating of 82 marks him out as a live threat — the risk is that he remains winless in recent starts.

runners_data.name: Tokyo Treasure
runners_data.note: Dylan Browne McMonagle takes over on this Patrick Foley-trained 4yo who has a consistent placed record at 7f on Good ground (3rd last time at this trip); tongue-tie worn, 27 days fresh, and showed enough in his last two to suggest he can hold a prominent berth competitively if McMonagle presses him forward.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last four starts, Tokyo Treasure did show a third three starts back, though eighth-placed finishes either side of it temper expectations; drawn in stall one and carrying 136 lb, he has run over today's trip before.

runners_data.name: Send Harry
runners_data.note: Evanna McCutcheon's 4yo carries headgear (hood and tongue-tie) and has been placed prominently over this course and distance multiple times; apprentice Jimmy Dalton claims 7lb which is significant, and a recent second over 7f on Good shows the form is live — the weight allowance could make him dangerous from a position just off the pace.
runners_data.comment: Send Harry is winless in his last five starts, though a second three starts back shows he can threaten at this level; a ninth last time out and 134 lb to carry are the concerns, though he returns quickly enough on familiar ground over today's trip.

runners_data.name: Bofa Beach
runners_data.note: Scott McCullagh takes the mount on this Mrs Harrington 3yo who stays on from off the pace — 34 days between runs after a solid third over 8f is not a concern, and the drop to 7f on Good to Firm could sharpen the finish; maps genuinely to midfield and benefits if the pace compresses the field.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last five starts and ranked tenth of thirteen on our figures, Bofa Beach faces a stiff task, though she has run over today's trip before and two placings from her last four runs — third last time out, and third three starts back — suggest she isn't without ability.

runners_data.name: Caitouna
runners_data.note: The race's lone front-runner for Colin Keane and Paul Flynn; won over this exact course and distance on Good and sets an uncontested pace today — the question is whether her 11-day turnaround and top weight at 127lbs blunts her late, but an unchallenged lead is a powerful tactical asset in this field.
runners_data.comment: Beaten sixth last time out and ninth two starts back, Caitouna has shown little consistency in recent starts and ranks 11th of 13 on our figures; the trainer's 1-from-22 form over the past fortnight is an additional concern, though she has experience over today's trip.

runners_data.name: Ballymagreehan
runners_data.note: David Marnane's 4yo is a genuine hold-up type by nature — two wins came over 8f at Gowran and Standside — but with so many closers in this field it cannot get the true rear position it needs; STYLE_FIT of 0.93 underlines the mismatch, and its chance depends on the field spreading out enough for a late challenge.
runners_data.comment: Ballymagreehan has been out of the frame in four of his last five starts, finishing seventh in each of his two most recent outings, and ranked last on our figures here; he has run over today's trip and going before, and a win three starts back offers a scant crumb of comfort.

runners_data.name: Fortuity
runners_data.note: Shane Foley rides for the in-form Mrs Harrington yard (5/31 in 14 days), and Fortuity was second over 8f and won over 7f on Good — the form is relevant; races naturally as a hold-up horse but is mapped to midfield due to the cluster of closers, meaning Foley may have to take a slightly more forward pitch than ideal, tempering the finishing effort.
runners_data.comment: Fortuity has won once in her last five starts, with a fourth and sixth in more recent outings, and she ranks 12th of 13 on our figures — hard to fancy. She has run over today's trip and returns after 37 days, but the official rating of 66 and draw at stall 13 are simply noted facts.

runners_data.name: Reimagined
runners_data.note: Nathan Crosse and Daniel McLoughlin (no wins in last 5 for trainer) saddle a 3yo whose recent run profile shows ability at 7f on Standside Good going; naturally races from the rear but the field's density of hold-up types means it will be shuffled into a midfield spot rather than its preferred closing position, diminishing the chance of a sustained finish.
runners_data.comment: Reimagined returns 26 days after a fourth, and her third three starts back offers a glimmer, though she remains winless in her last five and will need to find more from stall 11 off 122 lb.

runners_data.name: Summer Snow
runners_data.note: Peter Lawlor's 6yo has three career wins but recent form reads 9-0-5-0 and the layoff of 42 days is notable; a hold-up type at heart who has performed over 7f on Good, but the lack of recent action and a declining form curve make this hard to fancy even if it finds a clear run from midfield.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last five starts, Summer Snow nonetheless rates 8 lb clear of her official mark on our figures, and 42 days off gives her every chance to strip fresh over a trip and going she has experience of; the concern is that recent form has been patchy at best.

runners_data.name: Bundle Of Interest
runners_data.note: W J Lee's mount for Willie McCreery has been off 90 days — the longest layoff in the field — and while a 7f handicap on Good suits its profile, the extended absence is a significant flag; naturally a hold-up horse that needs a truly run race, pushed into a midfield map position, and that combination of rust and positional compromise makes this race tough on debut from such a break.
runners_data.comment: Third three starts back hints at better form, and Bundle Of Interest has experience over today's trip and going — our rating of 82 suggests she's capable of going close. The main risk is 90 days off the track leaving her short of peak fitness.

runners_data.name: Morehampton
runners_data.note: Ben Coen and JP Murtagh send out this 3yo who has placed at 7f on Good and posted an 8/10 record at similar going; a genuine hold-up type with no headgear, 27 days between runs, and a progressive profile on paper — but recent form (4-0-5-0-9) is going the wrong way and it needs things to fall right from mid-to-rear.
runners_data.comment: Morehampton has run over today's trip and going before and steps back out after 27 days, carrying 133 lb from stall five; winless in his last five starts, but he rates clear of these on our figures and is the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Neo Smart
runners_data.note: Jim Bolger's 5yo carries a tongue-tie and is shown prominent in the pace map; recent runs have all been over 8-10f so this 7f trip is a return to a shorter distance — the drop in trip could sharpen early speed but the form on ground this quick and over this distance is unproven in recent outings.
runners_data.comment: A winner six starts back, Neo Smart has found things tougher since with finishes of ninth, seventh, seventh and fourth before fifth last time out, though she has run over today's trip and returns on a reasonable 22-day break carrying 131 lb from stall 3.

races.paceDynamic: Caitouna is the lone confirmed front-runner and, with Colin Keane aboard, will stride out from the gate and set what should be a sustainable, controlled tempo over Gowran's 7f on ground riding Good to Firm throughout the card. Without any genuine pace rival to push her, the fractions are unlikely to be truly searching, which typically rewards horses that can travel close to the pace rather than those forced to make up significant ground late. Alfred Tennyson, Tokyo Treasure, Send Harry, and Neo Smart are the legitimate prominent types who will likely fill the early positions directly behind Caitouna, creating a bunched, pace-starved scenario for those behind them. The field carries more hold-up horses than the race shape can accommodate — Bundle Of Interest, Reimagined, Fortuity, and Ballymagreehan are genuine closers but are mapped to midfield because they cannot all get their natural rearward berth; of these, Fortuity (Shane Foley, in-form Harrington yard) and Bundle Of Interest (W J Lee) are best-placed to secure a workable position. This race shape — a single, unchallenged front-runner at a fair clip on a quick surface — decisively favours horses who race prominently and can sustain their effort through the final two furlongs, rather than hold-up types who need a truly run race to produce their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Caitouna Controls, Prominent Win
scenarios.trigger: If Caitouna dictates from the front unchallenged and the pace is fair-to-moderate, rewarding those who travel in her slipstream.
scenarios.body: Caitouna sets a measured tempo and the early-position horses — Alfred Tennyson, Tokyo Treasure, and Send Harry — secure the prime seats just behind, avoiding traffic in the straight; when Caitouna's advantage narrows, the horse with the best turn of foot from a prominent position pounces.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Holds All
scenarios.trigger: If Caitouna's controlled, uncontested lead at a comfortable pace proves sufficient to grind out a win as she stays on strongly.
scenarios.body: Colin Keane is experienced enough to judge pace perfectly on a front-runner who has already won over this course and distance, and if the field fails to mount a coordinated challenge she could simply stay in front all the way.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses, Midfielders Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the modest pace set by Caitouna tightens the field so much that a midfield horse finds a gap and runs on past the tiring prominent types.
scenarios.body: Bofa Beach or Ohailbhic, racing in a genuine midfield position with stamina to burn, could sprint past a congested group in the final furlong if prominent types have used themselves up trying to track Caitouna; the key is a clear passage at the two-furlong pole.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: True Closers Pounce Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace unexpectedly quickens in the middle stages and stretches the field, allowing redistributed hold-up horses to produce late runs.
scenarios.body: This scenario requires the race to be run at a genuinely strong gallop — unlikely with only one front-runner — and depends on Fortuity, Bundle Of Interest, or Reimagined getting clear and producing their natural closing finish; the STYLE_FIT discounts and redistribution make this the least likely shape.

watchPoints.text: Caitouna (Colin Keane) is the only confirmed front-runner in a 13-runner handicap — if she gets a clean break from the stalls she could be almost impossible to peg back on Good to Firm ground with a controlled lead.

Send Harry with a 7lb apprentice claim (Jimmy Dalton) represents a significant weight advantage in a handicap where margins are tight — watch if he secures an early prominent position and travels kindly just off Caitouna.

Bundle Of Interest has been off 90 days and is the biggest layoff flag in the race — if W J Lee pushes forward to compensate for the hold-up type's positional mismatch, the horse could burn out before the straight.

The entire card is riding Good to Firm at Gowran rather than the declared Good — ground is faster than anticipated, which may benefit the quicker-actioned prominent types and disadvantage those relying on a stamina-sapping pace.

Mrs Harrington runs two horses (Bofa Beach and Fortuity) — Shane Foley takes Fortuity over Scott McCullagh on Bofa Beach, suggesting the yard's preference, and both could cover each other tactically in a race where they race from different positions.

races.name: 1XBET.IE RACING LEGACY Handicap

runners_data.name: Glamazon
runners_data.note: Won over 10f on Good last time and steps back in trip; Mrs Harrington handler in form (5/31 14-day), wearing visor — she is the only front-runner in the race by default of redistribution, but her natural style is hold-up and the 0.80 style-fit flag means her chance should be moderated accordingly.
runners_data.comment: Glamazon has experience over today's trip and returns 23 days after her last start, our ratings marking her out as the one to beat in this field. A winner five starts back, her recent outings have been below that level, but on ratings she commands respect at the head of affairs.

runners_data.name: Kingcharles
runners_data.note: Beaten a long way in three straight runs on Good ground and carries a fades-in-finish flag; six days since last run is a quick turnaround and improvement from an 8/16 finish is needed here.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last three starts, including a pair of eighths, Kingcharles has experience over today's trip and a speed rating marginally above his official mark — though his recent consistency is a concern as he lines up from stall three carrying 142 lb.

runners_data.name: Oppenheimer
runners_data.note: 95-day absence is the headline concern for Colin Keane's mount; best form has come over 6f on Good, stepping to 7f for the first time in a while, and the fades-in-finish warning and 0/5 win record on similar going limits confidence.
runners_data.comment: Oppenheimer carries a solid 142 lb from stall one and has run over today's trip before, while our rating of 70 marks him out as a genuine threat — yet he's winless in his last five starts and that 95-day absence is the key question mark.

runners_data.name: Churchfield Lady
runners_data.note: Three runs in, all finishing 7th or worse, with a fades-in-finish tag and soft-ground form not directly translating — the p headgear may sharpen her, and 13 days since last run keeps freshness; Harrington stable form is positive but she needs a step forward.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last three starts, with back-to-back eighths her most recent efforts, Churchfield Lady faces a stiff ask from stall eight off 141 lb — though she has run over today's trip and comes here just 13 days after her latest outing.

runners_data.name: Gilts
runners_data.note: Won over this exact 7f Good trip at Gowran most recently and boasts the highest sim-going win rate of any runner; Jack Cleary (5) claims 5lb and the horse's true home is hold-up, pushed into the midfield map position — but the course-and-distance win is a real form reference point.
runners_data.comment: Gilts won last time out but that victory came 56 days ago, leaving fitness a slight query; she has run over today's trip and carries 140 lb from stall 5, though her two prior finishes before that win were modest.

runners_data.name: Sayonara
runners_data.note: Lightly weighted at OR 51 with a 3rd in her last comparable run; Adam Browne-Souza claims 7lb and she is a genuine hold-up horse shown in midfield on the map — in a slow-run race she will be coming from further back than the map suggests, making a clean run essential.
runners_data.comment: Sayonara arrives 24 days fresh and has run over today's trip, but he's winless in his last six starts and that fourth last time out is the best he's managed recently — a third five starts back offers a hint of ability, yet the 133 lb burden makes life harder still.

runners_data.name: Ballerina Dancer
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last three starts, with a ninth and two unplaced efforts, Ballerina Dancer arrives 67 days off the track and rates a significant 4 lb below her official mark on our figures — she has experience over today's trip, but little else to recommend her here.

runners_data.name: He's Holding Court
runners_data.note: Orla Tynan (7) claims 7lb on a horse with five runs at 7-8f on Good returning no wins or places; the tp headgear is retained but the fades-in-finish flag and 0/9 sim-going record make this a difficult assignment regardless of tactical position.

runners_data.name: Beau Army
runners_data.note: Wearing a visor, Chris Hayes in the plate — a previous 3rd at 8f on Good gives him the best sim-going placed record (7/15) of the lower-rated hold-up brigade; his true style means he will track from off the pace despite the midfield mapping, so ground to make up late is likely.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last six starts and finishing ninth last time out, Beau Army heads here ranked 12 of 15 on our figures, with a trainer firing at just 4% recently making it hard to fancy; she has run over today's trip and a third two starts back offers a sliver of hope.

runners_data.name: Garryowen Green
runners_data.note: Tongue-tie applied and Nathan Crosse takes the ride; all five recent runs on Good or similar have produced 0 wins and 0 places, and the fades-in-finish tag is consistent with a horse who has not yet found his 7f form — needs a career-best to factor.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts, with unplaced efforts sandwiched between two nineths and a fifth, Garryowen Green is hard to fancy at the foot of the rankings; he has run over today's trip before and returns after just 13 days, but his official mark of 41 tells its own story.

runners_data.name: Make The Tide
runners_data.note: W J Lee's booking for McCreery is the positive note; four runs show a best of 6th and the sim-going record of 2/4 without a win means he needs to find more than he has shown, and being a genuine hold-up type placed in midfield means his final furlong challenge will come from further back.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last four starts, Make The Tide at least has experience over today's trip, though recent finishes of ninth and back-to-back sixths leave plenty to prove; 37 days between runs and 140 lb from stall 15 add further questions.

runners_data.name: Sunrise Angel
runners_data.note: A 2nd and a 4th in two runs over 7f on softer ground suggest the step up to Good to Firm is a question; Andrew Slattery trains and rides, 4/39 in 14 days, and this horse is a true hold-up runner appearing in the midfield map simply because the field has no room for all closers at the back.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts, Sunrise Angel nonetheless catches the eye on our rating of 67 — ten pounds clear of his official mark — and he has run over today's trip before, with 24 days since his last run leaving him fresh; the worry is that his recent finishes offer little encouragement.

runners_data.name: Fontaine Khaled
runners_data.note: Best run was a 3rd over 7f on Good (Fontaine Khaled hist: 3/7f/GOO) which is directly relevant here; Jessica O'Gorman (7) takes 7lb and the horse's hold-up nature means the midfield mapping understates how far back it will actually settle in this congested field.
runners_data.comment: Third two starts back shows she retains ability, and our rating of 66 suggests she's ahead of her official mark — Fontaine Khaled has run over today's trip and returns after 36 days, but the seventh last time out is the concern for a filly yet to win in recent starts.

runners_data.name: Miss Ivor
runners_data.note: 65 days off track is the significant layoff and the fades-in-finish tag has been consistent across three outings at 7-8f; Jimmy Dalton (7) claims, but stepping into a 15-runner handicap after two months on the sidelines asks plenty of a horse without a placing to its name in recent form.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last five starts and ranked 11th of 15 on our figures, Miss Ivor faces a stiff task here; she hasn't threatened recently, though she has run over today's trip and comes back from a 65-day break.

runners_data.name: Ochtar Againn
runners_data.note: Wearing a p (hood or blinkers) and returning 27 days after last run; Paddy Harnett (5) takes 5lb and a previous 4th at 6f on Good is the best sim-going effort — the fades-in-finish flag is a concern at 7f but the weight claim and headgear give marginal positives.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last six starts, Ochtar Againn does at least bring distance experience to the table and a 27-day break could have freshened her up, but a fourth and a fifth amid four unplaced efforts make her tough to trust from stall 2 off 135 lb.

races.paceDynamic: Glamazon is the lone confirmed pace-setter — redistributed to the front because no natural leader exists in this 15-runner field, though her true style is hold-up and she races out of role at a STYLE_FIT cost of 0.80. With no rival applying genuine early pressure, the fractions should be measured and unhurried on this Good to Firm Gowran surface, creating a single-file procession rather than a true test of stamina. The field is saturated with horses whose natural home is hold-up or midfield — Make The Tide, Gilts, Sunrise Angel, Fontaine Khaled and others are genuine off-the-pace types redistributed into the midfield slots simply because they cannot all settle where they want — meaning the back of the field will be congested and the task from the rear will be harder than it looks. A sustainable, uncontested gallop over 7f on quick ground at Gowran typically rewards horses who can travel handy in the first four or five, switch off, and produce a clean turn of foot in the straight — the race shape here strongly favours a prominent-to-midfield runner who gets a clear run rather than a deep closer forced to find gaps through a tightly-bunched pack.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Dictates
scenarios.trigger: If Glamazon, racing out of natural style, nonetheless finds a low-pressure lead and controls tempo throughout the 7f.
scenarios.body: With no rival applying early heat, Glamazon sets a moderate gallop and the field strings out behind; any horse who travels comfortably just off the pace and quickens from second or third position in the straight benefits most.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Midfield Closers Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the steady pace compresses the field and several redistributed midfield horses get unimpeded runs to deliver late challenges simultaneously.
scenarios.body: Horses mapped to midfield who are true hold-up types get a fortunate run through a tightly-packed group; Gilts, whose last win came over this identical 7f Good trip, is best placed to capitalise on a clean passage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Glamazon sets a false, stop-start gallop and fades sharply inside the final furlong, inviting a sprint finish.
scenarios.body: Any horse with a clean enough position to quicken into the vacated lead benefits; Fontaine Khaled, who ran third over this course and distance, and Ochtar Againn with their previous placed efforts at the trip are best positioned.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Causes Upset
scenarios.trigger: If the congested hold-up pack produces traffic problems and a lightly-raced or under-the-radar horse finds daylight at the ideal moment.
scenarios.body: With 14 of 15 runners carrying redistributed or hold-up profiles bunching through the final quarter, a single horse finding a seam of clear running at the 2f pole could produce a surprise; Beau Army and Sayonara, both with recent placed efforts and flexible pace, are candidates.

watchPoints.text: Gilts is the most dangerous horse in the race on course-and-distance form — watch whether Jack Cleary (5) can get the horse a clear run from its true hold-up position given the congested back half of the field.

Glamazon racing fully out of her natural hold-up style on the lead (STYLE_FIT 0.80) means the pace could evaporate suddenly inside the final 2f — watch her body language turning for home as a signal for the whole field.

With at least eight genuine hold-up types crammed into a midfield map, traffic trouble in the straight is a live risk — watch for horses getting squeezed or checked between the 2f and 1f poles, particularly Sayonara and Make The Tide who will be looking for gaps simultaneously.

The going report consistently reads Good to Firm across all seven races at Gowran today — any horse with headgear changes (Glamazon visor, He's Holding Court tp, Ochtar Againn p, Beau Army visor) may react differently to the quick underfoot conditions than their soft-ground form implies.

Three Slattery-connected runners (Sayonara, He's Holding Court, Sunrise Angel) plus the trainer-jockey combination on Sunrise Angel itself could influence tactical decisions — watch whether any of the trio is ridden more prominently than expected to avoid blocking the others.

runners_data.name: City of Dubai
runners_data.note: Unbeaten in one start over this trip on good ground, trained by Pat Twomey with a solid 3/11 14-day record; sits on an OR of 120 but will not get his natural prominent position in this field and is effectively racing out of role from midfield, which tempers confidence despite the raw class.
runners_data.comment: City of Dubai won last time out and has run over today's trip, but ranked last on our figures with a speed rating of 61, he has plenty to find; the 25-day turnaround at least suggests he arrives fresh.

runners_data.name: Full Volume
runners_data.note: A genuine front-runner with a win over this course and distance on good ground, Shane Foley takes the ride for the Harrington yard; will push for the lead from the outset and has the course and distance form to make this a real test for Bellesque.
runners_data.comment: Full Volume shaped well last time out with a runner-up finish, and a win two starts back underlines his recent consistency over today's trip — the main concern is whether he can overcome that modest speed rating.

runners_data.name: Bellesque
runners_data.note: Joseph O'Brien's Dylan Browne McMonagle-ridden filly is the standout pace-setter on form — an OR=120 winner over this trip and going — and gets to run her natural race from the front on a flat course that suits her style; her two runs show 1-2 on similar ground at this distance.
runners_data.comment: Bellesque arrives in decent nick after a win and a runner-up in her last two starts, and she has run over today's trip before, but a speed rating of 55 leaves her well below the principals on these figures, making her hard to fancy at second bottom of the rankings.

runners_data.name: Sea Of Rain
runners_data.note: Jim Bolger's consistent filly carries a strong profile — five runs over this trip and related going, all placing — but is naturally prominent and has been pushed toward a hold-up position on this map because there is no natural space for her near the pace; her true style means any benefit from the rear is not guaranteed.
runners_data.comment: Sea Of Rain comes here on the back of a win last time out and has solid placed efforts two and three starts back, with experience over today's trip and a fit 15-day turnaround working in her favour; the main query is whether our rating of 77 leaves her vulnerable to the top-rated runner.

runners_data.name: Sergei Diaghilev
runners_data.note: Aidan O'Brien's colt steps back up to a mile after winning over six furlongs on good ground and is rising sharply in class; last run was 51 days ago, which is the most notable freshness flag in the field, though he carries OR=120 and Wayne Lordan takes over in the saddle.
runners_data.comment: Landed a win two starts back and has going experience to call on; the 51-day absence is the one query, but at the top of the ratings and carrying 131 lb from stall six, Sergei Diaghilev looks the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Venetian Power
runners_data.note: Joseph O'Brien's second string carries an OR of 120 and won over this trip and going on debut before a fourth at seven furlongs; will look to sit off the pace in a prominent role and use his mile form to challenge late, making him a natural beneficiary if the front two tire.
runners_data.comment: Venetian Power won last time out and has experience of today's trip and conditions, making him a clear threat from stall one; the main risk is whether he can back that up off just 23 days' rest carrying 131 lb.

races.paceDynamic: Bellesque and Full Volume are both confirmed front-runners who will contest the lead from the outset over this flat Gowran mile on good-to-firm ground, guaranteeing an honest, competitive gallop rather than a falsely-run affair. Bellesque, trained by Joseph O'Brien and ridden by Dylan Browne McMonagle, arrives as the higher-rated and more imposing of the two pace-setters, while Full Volume (Shane Foley) has shown real front-running grit in winning over this course and distance. The field contains more prominent-type runners than the race shape can accommodate — City of Dubai is a genuine prominent racer who is likely to find himself racing in a more restrained midfield role, and Sea Of Rain, also naturally prominent, may be pushed toward the rear of the small field as a consequence. With an honest pace set by two genuine leaders, this race shape most favours organised prominent-to-midfield runners who can travel comfortably just off the pace, conserve energy through the middle stages, and deploy a clean sustained finish from two furlongs out — true hold-up horses are thin on the ground here and those mapped wide of their natural position carry a meaningful style-fit discount.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Control
scenarios.trigger: If Bellesque and Full Volume set an honest but not suicidal gallop and one of them proves capable of quickening clear when challenged in the final two furlongs.
scenarios.body: Bellesque, the highest-rated runner with two runs over this course and distance, is ideally placed to dictate terms, and on good-to-firm ground her tactical advantage of controlling the race from the front is maximised; a horse that wins from the lead at Gowran on fast ground and hits the line first wins this shape.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Types Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the pace duel between Bellesque and Full Volume softens both slightly, allowing a prominent tracker sitting a length or two off the speed to swoop in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: Sergei Diaghilev and Venetian Power, both rated OR=120 and trained by the O'Brien yards with strong similar-going form, are positioned to travel smoothly just off the lead and benefit from any fade by the pace-setters; good-to-firm conditions suit their athletic, progressive profiles at this mile trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Burns Out, Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early duel between Bellesque and Full Volume is fiercer than anticipated and produces a noticeably strong tempo that burns off the leaders inside the final two furlongs.
scenarios.body: City of Dubai, despite being redistributed from his natural prominent position into midfield on this pace map, carries high class (OR=120) and one win from one run over this trip and going, meaning a fast pace could bring him into play; the style-fit discount applies, but raw ability could compensate if the race shape falls perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Slowdown, Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Full Volume or Bellesque eases off the pace early to avoid a war, the race becomes a slowly-run affair that degenerates into a sprint finish from the two-furlong pole.
scenarios.body: A muddling gallop compresses the field and advantages horses with the sharpest late acceleration, though in a six-runner field on a flat track this scenario is least likely given the presence of two genuine front-runners with winning form at this track; Sea Of Rain's strong recent course form over a mile on good ground could see her finish well, but she is racing out of her natural role here.

watchPoints.text: Bellesque and Full Volume will clash for the lead immediately — watch whether either rider concedes and settles, because if neither gives ground the early pace could be sharper than the going report implies and benefit the prominent trackers.

Sergei Diaghilev is 51 days off the track, which is the longest break in this field; watch his early movement and whether Wayne Lordan has to work to get him into his race, as any greenness at the start could compromise his prominent position.

City of Dubai is unlikely to secure his natural spot near the pace in a six-runner field with two confirmed front-runners and several prominent types — watch whether W J Lee attempts to push forward regardless, as that would increase early pace pressure dramatically.

Sea Of Rain's redistribution to a hold-up position is a function of field composition rather than natural style — watch whether Colin Keane ignores the pace map and presses forward early, which would further crowd the prominent positions and alter the race shape materially.

Good-to-firm conditions are confirmed across all Gowran races today — the ground is consistently fast and should produce true form, so watch for any horse that appears to be travelling comfortably within itself at halfway, as the flat mile will expose any stamina limitations in the straight.

races.name: 1XBET.IE COMMUNITY CHAMPIONS Race

runners_data.name: Benevento
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who has shown consistent form on good ground over shorter trips and steps up to a mile here; trainer De Aguiar returns modest 1/10 in the past 14 days and Benevento's recent finishes of 0-4-7-3 suggest form fluctuation, but his sim-going record is solid and he maps well to track Celtic Motif.
runners_data.comment: Benevento returns on a quick 13-day turnaround with experience of both today's trip and going, and a rating of 105 has him narrowly top-rated; third last time out gives him solid recent form. The risk is that he's winless in his last five starts.

runners_data.name: Rahmi
runners_data.note: A seven-year-old hold-up operator off a 30-day break, Rory Mulligan takes the 5lb claim; the horse's last five runs have all been over seven furlongs and he has struggled to fire on this type of ground, making the step up to a mile and a dependence on pace being set against him here.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts, Rahmi has nonetheless run over today's trip and returns on a manageable 30-day break, carrying 138 lb from stall two; our figures rate him second of seven, making him worth serious consideration on profile.

runners_data.name: God Of Power
runners_data.note: Three-year-old prominent racer trained by Andrew Slattery who has been building nicely — won last time over seven furlongs on good — and now steps up to a mile; a trainer strike rate of 4/39 in 14 days is modest but the form trajectory and style suit the likely race shape well.
runners_data.comment: God Of Power has one win in his last five starts, that success coming three starts back, and a ten-point gap between his official mark and our rating makes him hard to fancy; he has run over today's trip, at least.

runners_data.name: Anushka
runners_data.note: De Bromhead's filly carries genuine hold-up instincts — her natural style is to race from the back — but with several other hold-up types in this field she is unlikely to secure that position and has been placed in midfield on the map; her STYLE_FIT score of 0.92 reflects racing out of role, which tempers confidence in her landing in an ideal spot.
runners_data.comment: Anushka shaped with promise when third two starts back and has experience over today's trip, while her official mark of 81 leaves room to exploit on her best form — the main concern is that unplaced effort last time out.

runners_data.name: Keep It Together
runners_data.note: An eight-year-old hold-up stayer who has been running over 12-16f and drops sharply in trip to a mile; his going record over similar conditions is a concerning 0/11 with no wins or places, and the flagged tendency to fade in the finish makes him an outsider dependent on conditions that this race shape is unlikely to provide.
runners_data.comment: Yet to score in her last two starts, Keep It Together is lightly raced and open to plenty of improvement; drawing stall one, she carries 130 lb fresh off a 37-day break and remains unexposed enough to leave those efforts behind.

runners_data.name: Celtic Motif
runners_data.note: Lone confirmed front-runner trained by Joseph Patrick O'Brien (strong 13/74 form in 14 days) who won over a mile on good ground in his most recent victory; wearing a hood and handled by Sheridan, he has every chance to control tempo and dictate from the front without genuine pressure — the pivotal horse in shaping this race.
runners_data.comment: Celtic Motif arrives on the back of a win last time out and has solid placed efforts threading through her recent form, while experience over today's trip and going is a clear asset; the main concern is that our rating suggests she may be a shade below the very best here.

runners_data.name: Felix Guido
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from a 102-day layoff having gone 1-1-1 before a flat effort on good ground last time; the fade-in-finish tag and extended absence introduce significant uncertainty, and while O'Brien's yard is in strong form the fitness question over a mile cannot be ignored.
runners_data.comment: Felix Guido won three of his last four starts but that rich vein looks hard to trust here — he's been off 102 days, our rating puts him well below the field, and while he has run over today's trip, the weight burden of 137 lb adds another hurdle.

races.paceDynamic: Celtic Motif is the lone confirmed front-runner here and, with no genuine pace rival to challenge for the lead, J M Sheridan can dictate a controlled, sustainable gallop from the front on good-to-firm ground over a mile at Gowran. God Of Power and Benevento will look to press from prominent positions behind Celtic Motif, meaning there will be a degree of cover and pressure in the early stages but Celtic Motif is unlikely to be genuinely pressured into a fast pace. Keep It Together, Rahmi, and Anushka are natural hold-up types who will need the pace to be genuine enough to bring them into play in the straight, but on a comfortable lead the race may not generate enough tempo for pure closers to land late. The field carries more hold-up types than the map can accommodate at the rear — Anushka in particular is a genuine hold-up operator who has been redistributed to midfield because of congestion at the back, but she is unlikely to secure a true off-the-pace position. This race shape — a single uncontested leader, moderate pace, no pressure from rivals — strongly favours patient prominent racers who can track Celtic Motif and strike from a close-up position in the final furlong, rather than horses relying on a strong gallop to produce a sustained late finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Celtic Motif Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Celtic Motif is allowed to stride clear unchallenged and sets a controlled pace that suits a prominent tracker to pounce.
scenarios.body: Celtic Motif dictates every yard from flag to finish on a good-to-firm surface that rewards his recent course-winning form at the trip, meaning the race is run to his strengths; a close-tracking prominent type who can quicken off the steady tempo is ideally placed to take the spoils as Celtic Motif ties up late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Fight It Out
scenarios.trigger: If Benevento or God Of Power press Celtic Motif hard enough to shift the pace and turn the race into a contested duel that stretches the field.
scenarios.body: The increased tempo from two prominent types in close attendance burns out Celtic Motif and the winning move comes from the horse who has tracked just off them with the most energy in reserve; this shape suits a prominent racer with strong late finishing ability who has been saving ground throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is stronger than expected and the hold-up contingent gets a genuine gallop to aim at in the straight.
scenarios.body: Rahmi or Keep It Together would need an unusually fast tempo to bring their finishing kicks into play, and Keep It Together's tendency to fade in the finish is a further drag on this scenario; Anushka's redistributed position means she is unlikely to be far enough back to build the momentum her style requires.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse, Front Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Celtic Motif's pace is so slow it turns into a sprint finish and no hold-up horse can bridge the gap.
scenarios.body: A complete crawl benefits only those immediately on the heels of Celtic Motif and turns the race into a sharp tactical sprint that disadvantages the entire hold-up group; Felix Guido's long absence (102 days) and tendency to fade make this scenario particularly speculative despite his strong early form.

watchPoints.text: Celtic Motif — watch whether J M Sheridan elects to bowl along at a genuine pace or crawls the field to sleep; the entire race shape pivots on how fast he sets the early fractions.
Felix Guido — a 102-day absence with a fade-in-finish flag is a combination that could see him stop abruptly inside the final furlong, creating interference for horses tracking behind him.
Anushka — if W J Lee pushes her forward early to compensate for being denied her natural hold-up berth, she may be racing fully out of role and burning energy she cannot afford at this trip.

God Of Power — watch his early position; if Sam Coen (5lb claim) gets him slot in directly behind Celtic Motif before the first bend, he is perfectly placed for the likely race shape and his improving form makes him a horse to track throughout.

Keep It Together — the drop from 12-16f to one mile is extreme and his going record offers no encouragement; monitor pre-race market moves as a significant drift would confirm market scepticism matches the data.

races.name: 1XBET.IE COMMITMENT TO IRISH RACING (Ladies) Handicap

runners_data.name: Gatsby Grey
runners_data.note: Ten-year-old hold-up specialist trained by McKiernan; last ran 105 days ago which is a notable freshness flag, but recent form reads 550 and all last five runs were at extreme distances of 18f-26f — this 12f trip is likely too short and the horse has no wins or places on truly comparable going.|
runners_data.comment: Gatsby Grey has been winless in his last three starts but shaped with promise on his two fifth-place efforts, and a 105-day break could have him freshened up nicely; our figures suggest he's better than his official mark of 72 implies.

runners_data.name: Forthill
runners_data.note: Sole front-runner in the field, giving her a massive positional advantage; Twomey has 3/11 over 14 days suggesting stable in decent form, though the STYLE_FIT tag of 0.93 reflects she is racing in the role rather than out of it — this is her natural lead position and the race shape is perfectly configured around her.|
runners_data.comment: Forthill has shown consistent ability in recent starts, finishing third last time out and placing on two of her last four outings, and she has run over today's trip before — the main concern is whether she can convert her proximity into something more decisive, having yet to win in her last five starts.

runners_data.name: Pahlavi
runners_data.note: Nine-year-old hold-up horse with 14 of 15 similar-going runs on record and a positive 1W3P strike rate there; last five runs all on Good ground at 16f-20f, so the trip is well within range — the question is whether the single-runner pace is brisk enough to set up a late challenge from her natural rearward pitch.|
runners_data.comment: Pahlavi arrives with strong claims on our rating, where he heads the field, and has run over today's trip and going — a second three starts back underlines his quality. Yet to win in recent starts and carrying 161 lb for a trainer in lean form are the concerns.

runners_data.name: Liberated Light
runners_data.note: Last won on Good ground over 16f and has multiple places at that trip — the form profile gives her a genuine chance at this distance; operates from the hold-up position and trainer Kiely has just 0/1 in the last 14 days, suggesting no particular stable momentum behind this run.|

runners_data.name: Monntie
runners_data.note: Four-year-old with natural prominent-racing style and a 6/6 record on similar going including 0W2P — she has made the frame consistently on Good turf this season; a lightly-weighted 154lbs and only 14 days since last run keeps her fresh, and her likely position just off Forthill makes her the most natural challenger in terms of race placement.|
runners_data.comment: Monntie showed grit when third last time out, and has run over today's trip, but she's winless in her last three starts and carries a hefty 154 lb — compounded by a trainer operating at just 5% in the past fortnight, she faces stiff challenges here.

runners_data.name: Numidia
runners_data.note: Recent form is excellent — back-to-back wins on 13f and 14f Good ground — but this is a genuine hold-up horse that the redistribution mapping pushes forward; the 0.93 STYLE_FIT means she is unlikely to reproduce that closing form from a constrained midfield berth, though the trip and going are both ideal on pure form credentials.|
runners_data.comment: Numidia boasts back-to-back wins and returns fit on 21 days' rest, with experience over today's trip and going in his favour; however, he carries 154 lb and those two unplaced efforts in recent starts hint at inconsistency that makes him a each-way proposition at best.

runners_data.name: L'Un Deux Trois
runners_data.note: Ten-year-old McKiernan-trained hold-up type returning after 91 days off; all five recent runs on Good ground have produced finishes of 6th or worse, and the form string 3204/0 contains little encouragement — redistributed to midfield but this is a horse whose natural style gets suppressed by the race shape here.|
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts, though a second four starts back and third five starts back hint at ability; the query is whether 91 days off has left him short of peak fitness, and 153 lb is no help as he returns to familiar distance and going.

runners_data.name: Ms Messi
runners_data.note: 275 days off is an extremely significant flag — she last won on 12f Good ground and carries a fades-in-finish warning; the hold-up style is authentic but she is pushed into midfield by redistribution, and a long absence combined with a fade tendency makes this a speculative prospect at best.|
runners_data.comment: A winner in her last five starts but that came four runs back, and she arrives 275 days later, carrying a hefty 148 lb with a trainer firing at just 5% recently — she has run over today's trip, though the layoff and weight make confidence hard to find.

runners_data.name: Vervain
runners_data.note: Four-year-old with headgear (t) and a consistent pattern of placing 4th on Good ground over 12f; all five runs show she has found one or two too good in similar company, and stepping up to 12½f for the first time is an unknown — she is a true hold-up type occupying midfield by necessity rather than choice.|
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last five starts, with two fourths her best efforts in recent form, Vervain is hard to fancy from a lowly mark of 53 — though she has run over today's trip and returns on a reasonable 23-day break.

runners_data.name: Mapa
runners_data.note: Fades in finish and has registered six consecutive finishes of 3rd or worse with a 0W0P similar-going record; ran just seven days ago which is tight turnaround, and the hold-up style combined with the fade flag makes her a profile to oppose rather than support in this shape.|
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last six starts with three unplaced efforts on the bounce, Mapa is hard to fancy despite returning quickly seven days ago and having run over today's trip and going before; ranked ninth of eleven on our figures, she faces a stiff task under 142 lb.

runners_data.name: Anightaway
runners_data.note: Won over 14f on Good ground just two days ago — an extremely quick turnaround that merits monitoring; the 1W1P similar-going record and correct trip credentials are genuine positives, but the fade warning and the fact she is a hold-up type displaced into midfield by redistribution means the pace shape would need to collapse entirely to bring her back into the picture.|
runners_data.comment: Landed a win last time out but that came just two days ago, leaving recovery time a major concern, and he sits last on our figures in an 11-runner field. Has run over today's trip, though three unplaced efforts in recent starts temper enthusiasm considerably.

races.paceDynamic: Forthill is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 11-runner Ladies Handicap over 1m4½f on Good to Firm ground at Gowran, and with no genuine challenger for the lead, she can dictate a controlled, sustainable gallop from the front without any pressure through the early stages. The going report confirms Good to Firm conditions throughout the evening, which will keep the pace honest enough but will not force the tempo into anything punishing — on a flat track at this trip, a lone leader can control the fractions and stretch opponents at a time of her choosing. Behind Forthill, Monntie is the only other runner with natural prominent tendencies, meaning she is likely to slot into second or third early, creating a two-tier field with a large hold-up cluster behind. This race shape heavily favours the lone front-runner and any prominent racer positioned close enough to capitalise, as the hold-up horses will face a stern test of whether they can bridge the gap in the straight — the field holds more hold-up types than can realistically get to the front, with Numidia, L'Un Deux Trois, Ms Messi and several others all true hold-up profiles who will be racing out of their natural position somewhere in midfield, meaning the run to the line will depend almost entirely on how much Forthill has conserved, and whether any closer can manufacture enough momentum to overhaul her.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Forthill Leads, Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Forthill sets a controlled, uncontested pace and the hold-up pack fails to close the gap in the straight.
scenarios.body: Forthill dictates every fraction from the front on Good to Firm ground that will not punish a settled front-runner, and with Monntie the only horse close enough to apply any threat entering the straight, there is no mechanism to dislodge her early. The field of hold-up horses are racing out of their natural position and will need a strong finishing burst that a steady pace does not guarantee.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Pounces Late
scenarios.trigger: If Forthill sets just enough of a pace to string out the field but a prominent-tracking runner times a challenge perfectly inside the final two furlongs.
scenarios.body: Monntie, well-placed from a prominent pitch, would be ideally suited to this shape — sitting within striking distance the entire trip and needing only a sustained effort over the final quarter mile on a going that suits her course form. Pahlavi, who has consistent Good-ground handicap form, could also emerge from close order if the pace is truly honest.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Sweep Through
scenarios.trigger: If Forthill sets a genuinely quick early pace that burns herself out, leaving the race wide open for the closers to exploit a weakened leader.
scenarios.body: Numidia and Liberated Light, who both have genuine finishing ability when conditions are right, would be the most dangerous beneficiaries — both carry credible recent form on similar going. However, this scenario is weakened considerably by the redistribution issue: most closers in this field are not true hold-up types and will lack the natural late surge to overhaul a horse that has controlled its own race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes from Rear
scenarios.trigger: If the entire pace setup collapses into chaos and a lightly-regarded runner produces an unexpected finishing effort from an unpromising position.
scenarios.body: Anightaway's recent 14f win on Good ground is a legitimate pointer at this trip, and the horse carries only 146lbs with a 7lb claimer in the saddle. Gatsby Grey and Mapa carry fade warnings and poor recent form, so the true beneficiary of complete chaos would be a fresh enough runner with trip credentials — Anightaway fits that niche.

watchPoints.text: Forthill is the sole pace-setter and if she is allowed to control every fraction unchallenged, she becomes very difficult to catch — watch whether Ms J I Stokes parks her on the front early or allows the field to push up alongside in the first half mile.

Monntie is the one runner whose position close to the pace could prove decisive — watch how quickly Ms K M Ryan slots her in behind Forthill, because if she gets stuck wider or further back than expected the race shape changes significantly.

Numidia arrives in career-best form with back-to-back wins but her redistribution tag means she is unlikely to get the true hold-up position that produced those wins — watch whether Miss N Fahey tries to push forward early and how that affects her finishing effort.

Anightaway ran just two days ago and the medical/fitness angle is worth monitoring at the start — a horse returning on a 48-hour turnaround can be flat or alternatively fresh and sharp depending on how the first run was absorbed.

The entire field is 7lb-claimer-ridden throughout, which standardises the jockey advantage, but Nicola Burns (5lb) on Ms Messi holds the lightest claim differential — note whether the relative weight advantage translates into a position closer to the pace than the redistribution map suggests.
